reason: The Stage 09 draft has correct deterministic scientific output and a fail-closed zero-future audit, but it has no measured observability at any required execution boundary. The scoped source contains no monotonic timing, lifecycle/progress event sink, or payload-safe failure event for fixture materialization, fold fit, fold prediction, metric aggregation, or leakage audit. Report records carry run/fold/model identity, but runtime telemetry does not establish the immutable active stage=09, stage_revision=1, attempt=1, agent=quant identity. Because BacktestReport intentionally contains labels, forecast values and opaque evidence IDs for scientific evaluation, it must never be serialized wholesale into traces or progress events.

requested_changes.request: Add one immutable Stage 09 runtime identity (stage=09, stage_revision=1, attempt=1, agent=quant, implementation/backtest version) and a local injectable or existing in-process lifecycle/progress sink. Measure finite non-negative monotonic latency_ms at the actual fixture_materialization, fold_model_fit, fold_prediction, metric_aggregation and leakage_audit boundaries, plus run started/completed/fail_closed signals. Events must use compact allowlisted identity only: run_id; fold_id and model_variant where applicable; ticker/as_of/target/horizon/analysis_mode where applicable; dataset/feature/model/schema/backtest/metrics/audit versions; bounded row/fold/forecast/evidence counts; stable outcome/error codes; and bounded missing/degraded flags. Never include raw feature vectors, labels or actual/predicted numeric arrays, model coefficients, evidence IDs/content, prompts, chain-of-thought, private payloads, exception messages/repr/tracebacks, secrets, tokens or headers. Failure events must be emitted before re-raising the original exception without changing exception behavior. Keep telemetry outside BacktestReport and its canonical hash so the exact report_hash, folds, records, metrics, scientific PRELIMINARY classification, honest Full Model comparisons and zero-future audit remain byte-for-byte/deterministically unchanged. Add offline tests for event order/identity, finite latency, bounded progress, degraded and fail-closed signals, PRIVATE_SENTINEL redaction, and exact equality of scientific output with telemetry enabled versus disabled. Do not contact an external trace service.
